about.title: About me
about.bio1: Hi, I'm Victor Rosario, a Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of professional experience building scalable, production-grade web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
about.bio2: I integrate AI-powered features using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude), enabling automation of user workflows and improving data processing speed by ~50%. I've contributed to high-traffic platforms like gob.do and internal systems supporting thousands of concurrent users.
about.bio3: I focus on clean architecture, system reliability, performance optimization, and test-driven development. I'm comfortable making pragmatic technical decisions, mentoring teammates, and delivering high-impact solutions.
